comment: Shared fixture: Go (service/ml_notice_text_test.go) and vitest (dashboard MLMemberPanel test) must both render exactly these notice texts. Revision 1 = 2026-10-07 package doc 08 section 3 (counsel-approved). Revision 2 = 2026-10-10 doc 04 section 1 (final copy for counsel review; Draft badge stays until publication). The heading is shown as the title, not in the text. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line. include_ai_usage only affects revision 2. exclusions / legacy_exclusion_notes (omitted = none) append the exclusions summary paragraph exactly as mlNoticeText (server ml_notice body_text) and the dashboard panel do; it only lists what is NOT uploaded.

Acme has turned on Offload for your account. Here is exactly what that means.

What leaves your machine: a record of your workflow activity: file paths, the shell commands you run, git branch and repository names, which application or window is active, the domains of sites you visit, your device's power state, and timestamps; plus task summaries (start and end times, phase, test and commit counts) computed on your machine.

What never leaves your machine: the contents of your files, your source code, your prompts or AI conversations, screenshots, and keystrokes. Anything that looks like a credential is redacted before sending.

Where it goes: Kameas's cloud in Ohio, USA (AWS us-east-2), in a database area dedicated to your organization. Kameas processes it only on your organization's instructions.

Who sees what: predictions about your work come back only to your own tools. Your organization's administrators do not see your individual predictions. Kameas engineers have no standing access; emergency access is logged.

How long it is kept: workflow events and task summaries for 90 days, then deleted. Predictions and your organization's models for the subscription. If you leave the organization, sending stops immediately and your stored data is deleted within 72 hours unless your organization has chosen to keep it for the rest of the retention period. Backups expire within 30 days.

Your rights: your organization is responsible for this data. To access, correct, export or delete it, contact your organization's administrator. You can also read Kameas's Privacy Policy, section 13.

You decide. Offload is off for you until you turn it on below. You can turn it off at any time in Settings → Offload.

whats_new:
What's new

Your organization now also sends AI usage from your device, to suggest a better-sized model or when to start a new branch: the time, model size class and rung of each AI turn, token and context ranges, tool-call, failure and retry counts, how the conversation continued, and your responses to suggestions. The text of your prompts and AI responses, and model names, are never sent.

Until you select "I have read this", this new data is not sent. Everything you already approved continues as before.
